figures.sourceFidelity: The original shows one long-left cell, circular analog meter with separate lower terminals and an upper arched unnumbered scale, horizontal semiconductor, and five up-right incident-light arrows. The inspected 640x640 output preserves all those structures. Its needle is nearly upright and slightly left of vertical, matching the source direction and a larger deflection than the approved FIG230 low-side upper-left style pointer. Seventeen unnumbered ticks and component identification labels are explicitly modern additions, not source data. No numeric current, calibrated scale, heating source or current arrow is invented.
figures.widthEvidence: Full-resolution and normal-width are the same 640x640 media. Normal pixels show legible 32px English labels, separate connections, unobstructed arrows and a nonblank neutral figure. The 390px mobile prose screenshot shows the expected left viewport into fixed 640px scroll media, with a visible horizontal scrollbar; the browser measurement also confirms its right end is reachable. The narrower exercise container was independently measured, not inferred from prose.
figures.sourceUncertainty: Microscopic tick count and numeric current are not legible or queried. The disconnected fleck right of the source meter is omitted as a scan blemish. The schematic 94-degree pointer angle is not a calibrated source value.

figures.sourceFidelity: The original's top capacitor C, right vertical rectangular resistor R, abbreviated bottom supply E with two visible long-right pairs, and their unbranched series loop are preserved in the inspected 640x520 output. The supply omission mark is regularized to three dots without claiming two total cells. No source label is missing, no branch, meter, ion path, current direction, dimension, numerical value or solution equation is added. The full approved question and solution in Chinese then English are context only; the question and existing figure determine the drawing.
figures.widthEvidence: The 640x520 normal/full-resolution pixels show readable 32px C/R/E labels, equal capacitor plates, vertical resistor and correctly connected supply. The 390px mobile exercise screenshot shows the expected approximately 310px left viewport into fixed 640px media with a visible scrollbar, not a falsely shrunken figure. The same browser measured the exercise body and figure widths, the screen-transformed text and reachable right scroll end.
